name: City of Dixon Tyler EnerGov Permits, Plans and Code Cases

options._record_types: Dixon's Civic Access publishes 92,405 records: 17,192 permits, 142 plans, 269 code cases, 5 projects, 14,817 business licences and 59,980 inspections. The licences and inspections are 81% of that and neither is a project, so they are not collected here. Adding "license" or "inspection" to record_types turns them on; the agency's full census is reported in run metadata either way.
options._deep_paging: The search index serves no offset past 10,000 rows, so no single module can be read exhaustively beyond that however high max_pages goes. Dixon's 17,192 permits are over that line, which is why this config is bounded by a one-year recency window rather than by page count alone.
